title: Journal sync not reliable
body: There are journal sync reliability issues which result in changes made on one device not showing up on another device, or worse, being deleted when I open Lunatask on the other device. As a result, I hesitate to use the journal feature and the app is less useful than it could have been.
author: Emmanuel12346

title: Impressed!
body:
Hello! I rarely write reviews. But i am really pretty amazed with whats going on here. 

I have been searching for a comprehensive To-Do app for the longest time! And this is close to perfect. I (may be exaggerating) but it's enough for me.

Even the free version is comprehensive enough. 
But i will juse it just abit longer to see if i wanna pay premium for a lifetime usage. i am tempted, to say the least. 

It takes a little while to navigate through, but nothing complicated about it. 

All in all, im happy to have found it through recommendations on Reddit!
